name: application-swipe-action-row
title: Swipe Action Row
description: A list row that reveals archive and delete actions when swiped horizontally, shown mid-swipe with the row content shifted to expose the action buttons underneath.
useWhen: A mobile-style list (notifications, messages, inbox items) needs quick per-row actions without a persistent visible button.
The action is destructive or secondary enough that hiding it behind a swipe reduces visual clutter in the default row state.
avoidWhen: Users need to act on many rows at once — use `Bulk Action Bar` with checkboxes instead of one-at-a-time swipes.
The interface is primarily mouse-driven (desktop) — swipe gestures aren't discoverable without a touch affordance; expose the actions as visible buttons instead.
responsiveBehavior: Each row's content translates horizontally to reveal a fixed-width action strip; the action buttons keep a consistent tap-target width regardless of row content length.
accessibility: Swipe-revealed actions must also be reachable without a swipe gesture — provide an equivalent long-press menu or visible affordance for keyboard and screen reader users in a real implementation.
Each action button pairs an icon with an implicit color meaning (amber = archive, red = delete); provide a text label or aria-label since the icon alone isn't announced.
The row's underlying content order in the DOM should remain logical (name, message, timestamp) regardless of the visual swipe transform.

variants.title: Notification list
variants.description: A three-row notification list with the middle row shown mid-swipe, content shifted left to reveal amber archive and red delete buttons.
accessibility: In production, pair each swipe action with an aria-label (e.g. 'Archive', 'Delete') since the icons carry no text.

variants.title: Notification list (Dark)
variants.description: Swipe action row adapted for dark surfaces, including the action-strip colors and row shadow.
accessibility: Action-button colors meet WCAG AA contrast against their icon and against the dark list background.
